Container.Name: switchboard-server
Container.Overview: Home server companion for Switchboard, the X4 Pro smart-home remote firmware (github.com/stumarti/Switchboard). One instance per household: stores every room's profile centrally (lighting, climate, blinds, media, TV, HA connection) and serves a browser-friendly admin UI, so a multi-remote home authors each room's config in one place instead of on every physical unit. Advertises itself on the LAN as switchboard.local via mDNS, which is how each X4 Pro remote finds it automatically. REQUIRES Host networking - mDNS multicast does not cross Docker's default bridge network.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the admin web UI/API listens on inside the container. Networking is Host, so this is the actual port on the Unraid box too - pick something that doesn't collide with the Unraid GUI (80/443) or other host services.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Where room profiles (JSON files) are stored persistently - includes Home Assistant tokens and your WiFi password (see Globals), so back this path up like any other credential store, not just for disaster recovery. If you're migrating from an older locally-built homeremote-server container, point this at that same existing data path instead of a fresh one.

Config.Name: mDNS Hostname
Config.Description: Hostname this container advertises via mDNS (plain A record), and the hostname X4 Pro remotes look for from Settings -> Select room / SWITCHBOARD_SERVER_HOST in the firmware config.

Config.Name: mDNS Service Type
Config.Description: DNS-SD service type advertised (becomes _<value>._tcp.local). This is the record that carries the port - a proper DNS-SD/Bonjour query for this service returns host and port together, so devices don't need the port hardcoded.

Config.Name: mDNS Force IP
Config.Description: Optional. Force the advertised IP if auto-detection picks the wrong NIC (common on a multi-homed Unraid box). Leave blank to auto-detect.

Config.Name: mDNS Interface
Config.Description: Optional. Prefer this host network interface name (e.g. br0) when auto-detecting the LAN IP. Leave blank to auto-detect.
